correctness.rationale: A stationary new entry has an exactly uniform onto middle word on n-1 types. The all-singleton finite-position event has the exact ratio S(m-r,N-r)/S(m,N). The zero-truncated-Poisson local CLT with m/N->a gives independent Bernoulli singleton markers of parameter q=exp(-tau). Collisions among any fixed first k positions have probability O(1/n); rescue by any of the next k new draws also has probability O(k^2/n). Hence P(L>k|entry)->(1-q)^k. The exact Palm mean equals stationary onto mass divided by entrance flux; a second Stirling ratio gives mean->1/q. The packaged checker passed 134 finite exact and numerical assertions; the proof controls the infinite range.

value.rationale: The paper motivating the model explicitly distinguishes stationary onto mass from entrance flux because of local clumping, making the length of an entrance-initiated complete-window run a natural motivated statistic. Its whole limiting distribution for every fixed linear window ratio is a parameterized geometric law with explicit rate exp(-tau(a)); this complements the paper’s exponentially long time to first entry and differs from known logarithmic-window limits. The theorem is neither an arbitrary numeric slice nor only a mean restatement.
